# Foundry project APIM connection

Creates one project-scoped connected-model connection to an **existing** Azure
API Management gateway. The caller owns cardinality. No account, project, APIM
resources, API keys, policies, RBAC or app-role grants are created or read.

Uses `ApiManagement`, `ProjectManagedIdentity`, empty credentials and
`isSharedToAll = false`, with static OpenAI model metadata and body-based model
selection (`deploymentInPath = "false"`). The
[Microsoft sample](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/foundry-samples/blob/main/infrastructure/infrastructure-setup-bicep/01-connections/apim/modules/apim-connection-common.bicep)
uses preview category/authentication fields absent from the
[published ARM schema](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/templates/microsoft.cognitiveservices/2025-04-01-preview/accounts/projects/connections).
Schema validation is disabled only on this connection resource. Azure acceptance
and persistence still require real deployment/readback.

The existing project must have an identity authorized by the gateway owner.
Configure project/account identities through their owning modules; attaching an
identity does not prove which runtime token is used. This contract has no explicit
per-connection UAMI selector. Verify the caller's client/principal and audience in
gateway logs before activation, without broadening access to compensate.

The target is an HTTPS Chat Completions **base** URL, and the audience is the Entra
token resource URI, not a `/.default` scope. Static models follow the
[documented deployment/model shape](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/foundry-samples/blob/main/infrastructure/infrastructure-setup-bicep/01-connections/apim/APIM-Connection-Objects.md).
Agents must explicitly select `connectionName/gatewayDeploymentName`. This is not
an account-level AI Gateway association and does not redirect other model calls.

No discovery, deployment paths, inference/deployment API versions, custom headers
or Responses routing are configured. Verify the actual route, query, model body,
DNS/TLS/network access, token validation, gateway readiness, backend access and
request/response contract separately. Persistence and portal model visibility do
not prove successful inference.

## Composition

Source this submodule directly when another module owns or creates the project;
pass that project's ARM ID as `parent_id`. This avoids a dependency cycle between
an account, a separately managed project, and its connection. The account module's
`project_connections` interface is for projects that already exist in that account.
Neither interface adopts or changes project ownership.

For a local checkout, a direct call is:

```hcl
module "gateway_connection" {
  source = "./modules/project-connection"

  name             = "enterprise-models"
  parent_id        = var.existing_project_resource_id
  target           = "https://gateway.example.com/ai/v1"
  audience         = "api://gateway"
  enable_telemetry = false
  models = {
    chat = { model_name = "gpt-4.1", model_version = "2025-04-14" }
  }
}
```

For Registry consumption, select an actual released version containing this
submodule; v0.12.0 does not contain it. Do not treat this local example as a
released dependency.

There are no released resource-module connection addresses to migrate from
v0.12.0. Existing account, deployment and RAI-policy addresses are unchanged.
Adopting an already managed connection requires a separately reviewed state
handoff; do not configure two owners for the same connection.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_audience"></a> [audience](#input\_audience)

Description: THIS IS A VARIABLE USED FOR A PREVIEW SERVICE/FEATURE, MICROSOFT MAY NOT PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THIS, PLEASE CHECK THE PRODUCT DOCS FOR CLARIFICATION. Entra token-acquisition resource URI for the gateway (api:// or https://), not a JWT audience GUID or a /.default scope.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_models"></a> [models](#input\_models)

Description: THIS IS A VARIABLE USED FOR A PREVIEW SERVICE/FEATURE, MICROSOFT MAY NOT PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THIS, PLEASE CHECK THE PRODUCT DOCS FOR CLARIFICATION.

Static models keyed by the gateway deployment name accepted in the request body.

- `model_name` - Nonblank underlying model name.
- `model_version` - Optional underlying model version; defaults to an empty string.

At least one model is required. Agents select connectionName/gatewayDeploymentName, not the underlying model name.

Type:

```hcl
map(object({
    model_name    = string
    model_version = optional(string, "")
  }))
```

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: THIS IS A VARIABLE USED FOR A PREVIEW SERVICE/FEATURE, MICROSOFT MAY NOT PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THIS, PLEASE CHECK THE PRODUCT DOCS FOR CLARIFICATION. Project connection name: 3-33 alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen characters, starting with an alphanumeric character.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: THIS IS A VARIABLE USED FOR A PREVIEW SERVICE/FEATURE, MICROSOFT MAY NOT PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THIS, PLEASE CHECK THE PRODUCT DOCS FOR CLARIFICATION. ARM resource ID of the existing Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/projects project that owns the connection.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_target"></a> [target](#input\_target)

Description: THIS IS A VARIABLE USED FOR A PREVIEW SERVICE/FEATURE, MICROSOFT MAY NOT PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR THIS, PLEASE CHECK THE PRODUCT DOCS FOR CLARIFICATION. HTTPS OpenAI Chat Completions base URL without credentials, query, fragment, trailing slash, deployment path or operation. Verify the actual runtime URL separately.

Type: `string`

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: Controls whether telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see https://aka.ms/avm/telemetry.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Body-relative dot paths ignored on the connection. Ignored configuration is not sent to Azure; changes take effect only after apply.

- `cognitiveservices_accounts_projects_connections` - Connection body paths. Defaults to `[]` (send all properties). Ignore whole lists, not individual indices.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    cognitiveservices_accounts_projects_connections = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: Azure region for the module's telemetry deployment. May be null only when telemetry is disabled.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: AzAPI resource types and API versions owned by this submodule.

- `cognitiveservices_accounts_projects_connections` - Project connection type and API version. The preview default follows Microsoft's APIM connection sample; the ApiManagement/ProjectManagedIdentity contract is absent from the published schema.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    cognitiveservices_accounts_projects_connections = optional(string, "Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/projects/connections@2025-04-01-preview")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry configuration for the connection.

- `error_message_regex` - Patterns matching errors to retry.
- `interval_seconds` - Initial retry interval in seconds.
- `max_interval_seconds` - Maximum retry interval in seconds.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string), ["IfMatchPreconditionFailed", "RequestConflict", "CannotDeleteResource", "provisioning state is not terminal", "nested resources exist"])
    interval_seconds     = optional(number)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number)
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Connection operation timeouts. Set to null to use provider defaults.

- `create` - Create timeout.
- `read` - Read timeout.
- `update` - Update timeout.
- `delete` - Delete timeout.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    create = optional(string, "90m")
    read   = optional(string, "5m")
    update = optional(string, "90m")
    delete = optional(string, "90m")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_model_references"></a> [model\_references](#output\_model\_references)

Description: Agent model references keyed by gateway deployment name. Selection is explicit; existence does not establish inference readiness.

### <a name="output_name"></a> [name](#output\_name)

Description: Name of the project-scoped APIM connection.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: ARM resource ID of the project-scoped APIM connection.
